CRASAR-U-DROIDs measured-GSD building-damage audit

Public source:
  https://huggingface.co/datasets/CRASAR/CRASAR-U-DROIDs
Dataset DOI:
  https://doi.org/10.17603/ds2-fqy5-n314
Snapshot:
  47cf4ab3a94d42978975f7d23338a996125ac0e9
License:
  CC BY 4.0

Orthomosaics used:
- UAS 090403-Lancaster-Canyon-Gate.geo.tif, GSD 0.036510 m/px
- UAS 1001-Harlem-Heights.geo.tif, GSD 0.046720 m/px
- UAS 20230830-SteinhatcheeRiver.geo.tif, GSD 0.127000 m/px
- Satellite 1001-Harlem-Heights...10300100DB06A700..., GSD 0.305175781 m/px

Building-centred patches are generated locally from the supplied pixel polygons.
No CRASAR imagery or derived patches are redistributed in the release. The
release contains scripts, fixed source identifiers, result summaries, and
trained model checkpoints.
